base.ayame: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for an original 2D fighting game. ONE transparent PNG, exactly 1536x1024, 6 equal columns by 4 equal rows, each cell 256x256. NO text, grid, backdrop, shadows or labels. Exactly 24 full-body poses of the SAME adult fighter. All face RIGHT in side-view with a consistent body scale and clothing. Exquisite 1990s arcade pixel art, confident colored dark outlines, chunky intentional pixels, limited cel-shaded palette, charismatic expressive athletic anatomy. Each standing figure about 210px high; waist center x=128 within each cell, standing feet y=240. All limbs, hair, weapons and effects must fit within local x=10..246,y=10..244, NEVER spill into adjacent cell. Clean transparency, no soft glows. Use strict row-major pose order: row1: 0 idle guard A,1 idle guard B,2 walk forward contact,3 walk passing,4 opposite foot contact,5 walk second passing. Row2:6 crouch guard,7 jump knees tucked,8 standing attack windup,9 light attack right,10 heavy attack right,11 attack recovery. Row3:12 crouching low attack,13 airborne attack,14 projectile casting,15 rising special strike,16 rushing attack,17 ultimate special strike. Row4:18 standing hurt recoil,19 airborne backwards hurt,20 lying knocked down headLEFT feetRIGHT,21 standing guard,22 forward grab,23 victorious pose. Original character design, not an existing franchise. CHARACTER: AYAME / 綾女, beautiful charismatic adult Japanese female fan-wielding kunoichi, 27 years old, athletic graceful build, almond-shaped brown eyes, glossy black hair in a high ponytail with straight bangs and an amethyst ribbon. Stylish fitted plum-purple sleeveless short kimono jacket over dark leggings, white waist obi, gold trim, split violet hip panels, black shinobi boots and wrapped wrists. Carries a pair of metallic folding war fans, pale lavender and gold. Refined confident expression. Flowing purple sash trails LEFT. Acrobatic elegant poses. Light and heavy attacks slash with folding fans, projectile is a small violet crescent, rising attack is an overhead fan strike, ultimate is a wide violet fan arc. Attractive tasteful complete combat outfit, no nudity, adult proportions.

motion.kagura:
Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is an existing 24-pose character identity/style sheet, NOT the desired pose layout. Create a NEW supplemental animation atlas of 24 different IN-BETWEEN poses, preserving EXACTLY the referenced character's face, anatomy, outfit, accessories, weapon, palette, scale, and pixel-art style. This is animation production, not a redesign. Transparent PNG exactly 1536x1024, SIX columns FOUR rows, equal 256px cells. Every pose RIGHT-facing side view. Standing feet at local y=240, pelvis centered x=128; same ~210px standing height as reference. Full silhouette and weapon must stay inside x=10..246,y=10..244. No text, cell borders, floor, background or shadows. Crisply hand-pixelled chunky 1990s arcade pixel clusters, no vector smoothness or painted gradients. Motion is actual redrawn limb/cloth progression, not duplicates or shifted copies. Strict row-major layout:
Row1: [24] idle softly lowering knees and guard, [25] idle inhaling chest raised, [26] idle settling shoulders and flowing cloth, [27] idle returning to guard, [28] walk transition from forward contact toward passing foot, [29] walk transition from passing toward opposite contact.
Row2: [30] walk transition from opposite contact to passing, [31] walk transition from passing to first contact, [32] light attack halfway through windup, [33] light attack follow-through slightly retracting extended arm/weapon, [34] heavy attack halfway windup with weight behind, [35] heavy strike follow-through at full forward extension.
Row3: [36] heavy recovery halfway back to neutral, [37] jump ascent stretching body and bent legs, [38] jump descending with legs extending for landing, [39] forward run/dash foot contact leaning low, [40] forward run/dash passing foot leaning low, [41] lowering into crouch knees half bent.
Row4: [42] guard braced against impact, [43] hurt recovery halfway back upright, [44] projectile charging before release, [45] ultimate attack charging with raised weapon/fists, [46] ultimate follow-through slashing/punching RIGHT with small crisp colored arc, [47] getting up from ground on one knee.
All cells show the same original character as reference. Frame order mandatory; no pose may spill outside its cell.
Character: KAGURA. Preserve referenced identity exactly.
